subject: Vendor security questionnaire: SIG vs CAIQ — clarifying asks
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Evans <claire.evans@medisys.health>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medisys.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor security questionnaire: SIG vs CAIQ — clarifying asks

Hi Claire / Tom — thanks again for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can move the security intake forward: 

Recap (from our side)
- You want Redwood to start the vendor security intake to unblock procurement and security review.
- Primary concerns: HIPAA scope (PHI), SOC 2 evidence, and data residency (US).
- Procurement will need an estimated timeline and a draft BAA.

Clarifying questions / asks
1) SOC 2 status: you mentioned an audit is in flight — can you confirm whether it will be Type II and the expected completion quarter? If you have an interim report / readiness assessment, that helps speed the review.
2) Questionnaire type: would you prefer SIG (full CAIQ-style profile) or a shorter CAIQ-only prefill? We can initiate a SIG and prefill most fields to reduce back-and-forth.
3) HIPAA / PHI: please confirm whether Medisys will send/receive PHI to Redwood in production or for testing. That affects evidence and the BAA scope.
4) Data residency: confirm that US-only hosting is required. If so, which regions/providers are acceptable (AWS us-east-1, us-west-2, GCP us-central1)?
5) Evidence owners: please share a point of contact for (a) SOC2 evidence, (b) network/infra diagrams, and (c) procurement.

Next steps we propose
- If you confirm SIG as the preferred path, we will open the SIG intake, upload a preliminary prefill (attached), and route any outstanding questions to your evidence owners.
- We can provide a draft BAA for procurement to review in parallel.

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill_template.xlsx (prefill stub we use to accelerate SIG), sample BAA (we can send if you confirm).

Can you please reply with answers to 1–5 and attach the SOC2 contact and any interim artifacts if available? Happy to hop on a 20-minute follow-up if that's easier.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Rachel.Kim@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142
From: Claire Evans <claire.evans@medisys.health>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medisys.health>, procurement <procurement@medisys.health>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire: SIG vs CAIQ — clarifying asks

Thanks Rachel — quick answers below. Appreciate the clear summary.

1) SOC 2: We're in the middle of our Type II cycle; SOC 2 Type II expected Q3 2026 (target late August). We don't have a final report yet but we can share an internal readiness assessment and our SOC roadmap.
2) Questionnaire: SIG would be ideal — our security team prefers a SIG/CAIQ bundle since we cross-reference PCA questions. If you can prefill the SIG, that will save a lot of time.
3) HIPAA / PHI: Yes, Medisys will send limited PHI (appointment metadata and provider notes) to support the Redwood-powered recommendation feature. We need BAA coverage for production.
4) Data residency: US-only required. AWS regions are preferred (us-east-1 primary, us-west-2 acceptable for failover).
5) Evidence owners: attaching a spreadsheet with owner contact info (Medisys_RiskOwners.xlsx). SOC2 contact: Tom Alvarez (cc'd). Procurement: procurement@medisys.health.

Timeline ask: procurement would like a completed SIG prefill and high-level evidence list within 10 business days to move contracts. Is that feasible?

Thanks — Claire
Claire Evans
Head of Security Operations | Medisys Health
claire.evans@medisys.health
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Evans <claire.evans@medisys.health>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medisys.health>, procurement <procurement@medisys.health>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire: SIG vs CAIQ — clarifying asks

Looping you both in with Claire's answers. Action plan I'm proposing so we hit procurement's 10-business-day ask: 

Action items
- Karthik: please open the SIG in our vendor intake portal today and import the redwood_sig_prefill_template.xlsx. Prefill the common infra, encryption, and identity sections (owner: Karthik). Target: prefill submitted by Mon 2026-06-22.
- Ben: prepare a high-level evidence list and request packet for Claire/Tom (owner: Ben). Include SOC 2 interim checklist, network diagrams, encryption configuration snapshots, and BAA draft. Target: send packet by Tue 2026-06-23.
- Rachel: coordinate follow-up meeting with Claire/Tom for a short security walkthrough (20–30m) the week of 2026-06-29. I'll also attach a draft BAA in that thread once Ben confirms list.

Notes / constraints
- Medisys requires US-only hosting (AWS us-east-1 primary) and will require BAA for PHI. We'll need to confirm KMS details for customer-managed keys — flagging as a potential procurement question.
- Claire indicated SOC 2 Type II due late August; we should note that final SOC 2 report will likely arrive after procurement's current deadline. The prefill + interim evidence should keep things moving.

I'm attaching Claire's email inline for reference. CC'd procurement to keep them in the loop.

Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
